name: exp_multic
summary: A multi-currency martingale-style EA that simultaneously trades 10 currency pairs without any technical indicators. It increases position size when a trade is profitable and reverses direction when losing, closing all positions when overall portfolio profit or loss thresholds are hit.
summary_zh: 这是一个多货币对马丁格尔式EA，同时交易10个货币对，不使用任何技术指标。当持仓盈利时加仓，亏损时反转方向，当整体投资组合盈亏达到阈值时平掉所有仓位。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是基于多货币对的网格马丁格尔变体：不使用任何技术分析指标，而是通过盈亏反馈来决定交易方向和仓位大小。入场条件为：当没有持仓且可用保证金超过阈值时，按预设方向（BUY或SELL）以最小手数开仓。出场条件包括三种：一是当整体权益与余额之差超过止损线(loss)或止盈线(profit)时关闭所有仓位；二是当单个持仓盈利超过Lot[i]*k_change时加仓；三是当单个持仓亏损超过-Lot[i]*k_change时反转方向并平仓。仓位管理采用类马丁格尔方式：盈利时加仓（Lot递增minLot），方向反转时重置为最小手数，这实际上是一种反马丁格尔策略（盈利加仓）。资金管理通过全局止损/止盈参数和保证金门槛来控制，但缺乏单笔止损保护，风险敞口可能无限放大。
strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept is a multi-currency anti-martingale variant that uses profit/loss feedback rather than technical indicators to drive trading decisions. Entry conditions: when no position exists for a symbol and free margin exceeds the threshold, it opens a position in the predetermined direction (BUY or SELL) at minimum lot size. Exit conditions include three mechanisms: first, when the portfolio-wide equity-balance difference exceeds the loss or profit threshold, all positions across all 10 pairs are closed simultaneously; second, when an individual position's profit exceeds Lot[i]*k_change, a new minimum-lot trade is added in the same direction (position scaling); third, when an individual position's loss exceeds -Lot[i]*k_change, the direction is reversed and the position is closed. Position sizing follows an anti-martingale approach: the lot size increases by minLot each time the position is profitable enough, and resets to minLot upon direction reversal. Money management relies on global portfolio-level stop-loss and take-profit thresholds plus a margin requirement for new entries, but lacks per-trade stop-loss protection, allowing risk exposure to grow significantly during adverse market conditions.

parameters.name: loss
parameters.description: 全局止损阈值（余额与权益之差），超过则关闭所有仓位
parameters.description_en: Global stop loss threshold (balance-equity diff), closes all positions

parameters.name: profit
parameters.description: 全局止盈阈值（权益与余额之差），超过则关闭所有仓位
parameters.description_en: Global take profit threshold (equity-balance diff), closes all positions

parameters.name: margin
parameters.description: 最低可用保证金要求，低于此值不开新仓
parameters.description_en: Minimum free margin required to open new positions

parameters.name: minLot
parameters.description: 最小交易手数，也是每次加仓的增量
parameters.description_en: Minimum lot size and incremental step per addition

parameters.name: k_change
parameters.description: 加仓或反转方向的条件系数，与当前手数相乘决定阈值
parameters.description_en: Condition coefficient for adding/reversing, multiplied by current lots

parameters.name: k_closse
parameters.description: 单笔获利平仓系数，与最小手数相乘决定获利平仓阈值
parameters.description_en: Single-trade profit close coefficient, multiplied by min lot

pros: 多货币对分散风险，不依赖单一货币对走势
反马丁格尔策略在趋势行情中可实现盈利加仓放大收益
全局止损和止盈机制提供组合级别的风险边界
无需技术指标，逻辑简单直观，便于理解和调试
pros_en: Multi-currency diversification reduces dependence on any single pair's movement
Anti-martingale approach amplifies gains during trending markets by scaling into winners
Portfolio-level stop-loss and take-profit provide overall risk boundaries
No technical indicators required; logic is simple and straightforward for debugging
cons: 反马丁格尔在震荡市中反复反转会导致频繁亏损和手续费侵蚀
缺乏单笔止损保护，单品种亏损可能远超预期
加仓机制可能使持仓手数不断增大，导致保证金不足或爆仓风险
所有货币对使用相同的参数，未考虑各品种的波动率差异
全局止损阈值1900在组合10个货币对时可能过小，容易误触发
cons_en: Anti-martingale causes repeated reversals and commission drain in ranging markets
No per-trade stop-loss protection; individual position losses can far exceed expectations
Position scaling can cause lot sizes to grow uncontrollably, risking margin calls
Same parameters applied to all 10 pairs without accounting for individual volatility differences
Global stop-loss of 1900 may be too tight for a 10-pair portfolio, causing premature liquidation
improvements: 为每个货币对添加独立的止损和止盈，而非仅依赖全局阈值
根据各货币对的ATR或波动率动态调整k_change和k_closse参数
添加新K线检查（new bar check），避免每个tick都执行交易逻辑导致过度交易
加入点差过滤和最大持仓手数限制，防止极端行情下的过度敞口
improvements_en: Add per-symbol stop-loss and take-profit instead of relying solely on portfolio-level thresholds
Dynamically adjust k_change and k_closse based on each pair's ATR or volatility characteristics
Add new bar check to prevent excessive trading on every tick
Implement spread filtering and maximum position size limits to prevent overexposure in extreme markets

risk_points: 反马丁格尔加仓机制可导致持仓手数无限增长，在极端行情下面临爆仓风险
缺乏单笔止损，单品种最大亏损仅由k_change反转条件控制，但反转后立即反向开仓可能再次亏损
全局止损可能被跳空缺口穿越，实际亏损可能远超设定值
10个货币对同时持仓且无关联性风控，可能在黑天鹅事件中遭受系统性亏损
risk_points_en: Anti-martingale scaling can cause unlimited lot growth, risking account blowup in extreme markets
No per-trade stop-loss; maximum per-symbol loss is only controlled by k_change reversal, but immediate re-entry in opposite direction can compound losses
Global stop-loss can be gapped through during illiquid periods, resulting in actual losses far exceeding the threshold
Simultaneous 10-pair positions without correlation risk management can cause systemic losses during black swan events

summary_en: A multi-currency martingale-style EA that simultaneously trades 10 currency pairs without any technical indicators. It increases position size when a trade is profitable and reverses direction when losing, closing all positions when overall portfolio profit or loss thresholds are hit.
